messages:
marta: Quick sync — I'm prototyping a 'burst-to-hosted' fallback for cases where Dedicated queues spike. sketch: https://gist.github.com/marta/burst-fallback (short). Need opinions on isolation guarantees and telemetry we should emit.
lin: Curious — what's the hard requirement on data isolation? can we guarantee no KV/Prefix cache leaks when a request is routed to hosted?
raj: We cannot promise identical isolation unless tenant opts in. Hosted path uses shared KV cache and different encryption keys. We need a strip-sensitive-data step or mask token before reroute.
sam: Options: 1) sanitize request (strip sensitive fields) 2) keep request but set preserve_customer_kv=false so KV cache isn't attached 3) deny fallback for "high_trust" enterprise customers. Tradeoffs: latency + correctness.
dana: From compliance POV, default should be deny for enterprise contracts with isolation clause. For PLG users, fallback as opt-in in console. Also require audit log entry and egress region check.
lin: For API shape I suggest adding a per-route flag and an explicit fallback policy enum. Example PATCH: ```
PATCH /v1/routes/:id
{
  "fallback_policy": "hosted_burst", // enum: none | hosted_burst | downgrade_variant
  "fallback_config": {
    "isolate_on_fallback": true,
    "preserve_customer_kv": false,
    "max_forward_tokens": 1024
  }
}
```
raj: +1 to explicit policy. Also add "fallback_audit_level": "full|minimal" so ops can pick how much payload is persisted in logs. Default minimal.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling patch to routing-proxy queued (sha: a1b2c3). will add 0.1% canary for 30m.
sam: Telemetry: emit a single event route_decision with fields: tenant_id, route, fallback_type, fallback_reason, model_variant_in, model_variant_out, cost_estimate_cents. retention 90d for SRE, 365d masked for compliance.
dana: Also need a dashboard tile: "Fallbacks by tenant" + top reasons, and an alert if fallback rate > 1% for any enterprise tenant for 10m.
lin: UX: console toggle per-tenant "Allow hosted burst fallback" with two helper warnings: "May route to shared hosts" and link to contract settings and egress region picklist. Default off for tier Enterprise, on for Starter with help text.
marta: Implementation notes: runtime should mark requests with header X-Redwood-Fallback=hosted_burst and set tenant_fallback_id so we can trace. Must ensure KV cache keyspace != dedicated keyspace.
raj: Concern: what about model variant fallback? If primary variant is quantized-dl1 and hosted uses quantized-dl2, we must surface model_delta metric and degrade gracefully. Add fallback_reason "variant_unavailable" or "capacity_surge".
sam: We should also have automatic rollback: if hosted fallback sees >5% failure within 5m, pause fallback for that route and notify owner.
dana: Can we tie this into rollouts UX? If a route does canary rollout, the fallback setting should be part of the rollout config so we don't silently change behavior mid-rollout.
marta: Action items: lin + raj to sketch API change and default rule table; sam to add telemetry schema; dana to draft console copy and compliance checklist. I'll own rollout plan and canary gating.
lin: I'll start the API PR. planning to include example curl in the spec.
raj: I'll prototype the sanitize filter and run a perf check (expect +8-12ms median).
sam: I'll add telemetry proto and dashboard queries.
dana: I'll loop in legal for contract flags.
marta: Thanks all — keeping this thread for tracking. Ping me if you need to be added to the canary. :thumbsup:
